messages:
deploy-bot: Promotion blocked: `redwood/service@sha:aa11bb` failed artifact publish -> registry (timeout). Holding release window. see: https://ci.internal/jobs/5556/logs

sam: which step? deploy-bot, error details please.

deploy-bot: job=push-image-5556 runner=selfhosted-8 error=upload chunk failed: 504 Gateway Timeout after 120s; attempts=3

lina: this started hitting after we added the telemetry-agent bundle (PR #4890). image grew from 900MB -> 1.7GB. our small runners struggle with big multipart uploads.

chris: do we have registry-side logs? ops-bot, any known ingress throttles right now?

ops-bot: Alert: registry-proxy eu-west reported increased 5xx rate between 09:12-09:40 UTC. Root cause: upstream GCS slow PUTs. #inc-2026-0321.

ci-bot: excerpt from push-image-5556:
```
Layer 4/6: 1.7GB
PUT /v2/blobs/uploads/: 504 Gateway Time-out
retry (1/3)
PUT /v2/blobs/uploads/: context deadline exceeded
```

sam: short options: A) revert PR #4890 (smaller image) and rebuild, B) pin release to previous working image `sha:99aa88`, C) retry push with adjusted upload config (lower concurrency, longer timeout), D) push to mirror then promote from mirror.

lina: revert is quick (remove telemetry bundle) but that loses feature. maybe we can rework into streaming layers later. Revert+rebuild timeline: ~40m.

chris: pin to `sha:99aa88` and continue would be fastest to keep schedule. but we need explicit approval for pinning a release artifact.

sam: release window closes in 2h. what's risk appetite? If we pin, open a follow-up to ship telemetry as a separate image or use lazy download.

lina: I'm +1 on revert to keep release clean. I'll cut revert branch now.

ci-bot: PR created: `revert-4890-remove-telemetry-bundle` -> pipeline `build-image-5567` queued. link: https://ci.internal/pr/5567

chris: queued on selfhosted-2. expect build ~30m. monitoring.

ci-bot: build-image-5567: SUCCESS image pushed -> `redwood/service@sha:cc22dd` (staging). pushed to registry-mirror eu-west.
deploy-bot: starting canary for sha:cc22dd -> staging (10% -> 50% over 15m).

ops-bot: canary health: all checks green, latency within SLO. one flaky integration (payment-flow) 1/10 failures, appears unrelated.

sam: given single flaky run and green perf, go ahead with manual promote. i'll sign off. :white_check_mark:

chris: promoting from mirror -> prod: `deployctl promote --image=cc22dd --from=mirror-eu --to=prod --force`

deploy-bot: promote succeeded. release tag created: `release/2026-03-21-rc2`. :rocket:

lina: follow-ups: 1) I'll rework telemetry bundle into multiple smaller layers and add CI check to warn if image >1.2GB. 2) ops to document registry mirror promote path + set default UPLOAD_CONCURRENCY=2 for large layers.

sam: adding release note: "Rollback of telemetry bundle for stability; will reintroduce in a follow-up with streaming layers."

chris: arch note: also file ticket to detect big layer additions in PR diff (e.g., large binaries) and auto-signal owners.

ops-bot: archived failed artifact at s3://releases/blocked/1779998888/; removed candidate sha:aa11bb from promos.

sam: thanks all. saved the window. tagging QA to triage flaky payment-flow e2e separately. :tada:
